title: Just Juice Bar Below Zero Frozen Berry Gummy 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Frozen Berry Gummy from the Just Juice Bar Below Zero Range is a sweet, playful blend with a frosty edge. A mix of ripe Berries brings juicy, tangy sweetness, lifted by a burst of cool Ice for freshness. The flavour is finished with a chewy confectionery twist, creating a vape that balances fruit brightness with a candy-inspired depth. Crafted with nicotine salts, this e-liquid offers quick nicotine delivery and a smoother throat experience, making it perfect for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping in pod kits and pens. With 5mg, 10mg and 20mg strengths available, it caters to a range of users. Produced in the UK with a 60PG/40VG ratio, Just Juice Bar Below Zero Range Nic Salts are made for clear, vibrant flavour with subtle vapour production, offering disposable-style profiles in a refillable 10ml format. Please Note : All flavours in the Just Juice Bar Below Zero Range feature a subtle hint of ice to enhance the flavour profile.
